metadata.source: TMD FY2569 S-band dual-pol e-bidding TOR (identical technical package across all four stations; extracted from Attach_TOR_1.pdf)
metadata.note: TOR contains NO brand names. Spec is technology-neutral (magnetron/klystron/solid-state all allowed). Contrast: RRD Phimai/Udon draft TOR names LEONARDO/Gematronik and requires 850 kW (per dossier).

qualifications.prior_supply_contract: within 10 years before submission; full contract copies required
qualifications.dealer_appointment: 5.2 - manufacturer or Thai distributor appointment required
qualifications.standards: 5.3 - ISO 9001:2015 + manufacturer must have WMO/UNDP/NATO project record
qualifications.solid_state_alt: if solid-state transmitter offered: >=5 installed sites of the exact model

antenna.type: Parabolic Prime Focus with Dual-Pol Feed Horn

transmitter.type: Magnetron or Klystron or Solid State
